expected_form.problema: The cooling tower isn't circulating water: the fill isn't getting wet and the pump runs dry; the main valve was shut because of a drip from a rotten hose and the line's 1/2" shutoff valve won't open properly.
expected_form.diagnostico: 1/2" ball valve seized with the gasket gone and beyond repair; the 5/8" neoprene hose burst at the tower fitting.
expected_form.solucion: Replaced the 1/2" ball valve and the reinforced 5/8" neoprene hose; feed restored, the tower wets the fill again and the pump motor sounds fine.
expected_form.notas: The pump motor was already sounding fine by the end; the technician had another stop pending.

user_utterances.text: Can you hear me?... ok, I'm at building seven, right by the cooling tower... I've got the order for the no-circulation call... ok, let's go.

So the tower isn't wetting the fill... the pump is running dry and I shut the main valve because it drips from a hose that's rotten already... and the line's shutoff valve won't open right, ok, that valve... the half inch one, the small one.

I pushed pressure through with the service hose and the water won't pass... the valve's gasket is just gone, it pops when pressure goes in... the tower hose burst at the fitting too... the whole valve has to go, there's no repairing it.
No, no — it was the 1/2 one, not the 3/4!... the half inch one, look, I've got the old one right here in my hand... one piece, half inch, that's it.
The hose is the five eighths neoprene one, reinforced... a one meter run... one piece, and while you're at it jot down that the pump motor was already sounding fine by the end.
—an hour, like I've been telling you... ok, ok... sixty minutes, put down an hour and that's it.
Ok, ok, it's perfect, don't repeat the whole thing!... send it already, I've got another stop to get to.
